content.short: Alchemy University provides Web3 education resources.
content.description: Alchemy University offers a suite of free web3 education courses including a 3-week Javascript for blockchain beginners course and a 7-week Ethereum Developer Bootcamp. The web3 JavaScript crash course covers the basics of programming through advanced topics to prepare developers for learning Solidity and building Ethereum apps. The Ethereum Developer Bootcamp includes interactive coding challenges, video lessons, projects and expert instructors that teach you how to build smart contracts, master solidity, and become a web3 developer.
